name: Hyperparameter Configuration for Stochastic Gradient Estimation
aliases: Hyperparameter Configuration for Stochastic Gradient Estimation Methods
definition: A set of hyperparameters for optimizing differentiable rendering methods, including first-order (OurG, OurH) and second-order (OurHVP, OurHVPA) estimators, applied to tasks such as QUAD, BOX2, BOX10, MUG, SHAD, BUNNY, TEXTURE, CNN, and CNN5.
